|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Captain Piett (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 2. Twice per game during opponent's turn, may place 3 cards from hand in Force Pile to draw 2 cards from your Reserve Deck.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Twice per game during opponent’s turn, may place three cards from hand on your Force Pile to draw top two cards from Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 2.” → “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “3” → “three”; “in” → “on your”; “2” → “top two”; removed “your”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 33. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Captain Piett]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Captain Piett (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Captain Piett]]. Code OVS4 · GEMP id 1104_33.
